welcome.heading: Godavari GeoSeva 2027
welcome.subheading: Your Digital Guide to Godavari Pushkaralu
welcome.description: Discover verified locations of river ghats, drinking water facilities, public toilets, medical camps, shelters, and essential civic infrastructure through our interactive GIS mapping platform.

ghats.heading: Sacred Bathing Ghats & Riverfronts
ghats.subheading: Pushkar Ghat, Kotilingala Revu & Goshpada Kshetram
ghats.description: Navigate safely to 24x7 illuminated ghats equipped with river safety barricades, life-jacket stations, SDRF rescue teams, and dedicated elder and wheelchair ramps.

water.heading: Purified Water & Sanitation Network
water.description: Locate chilled RO drinking water posts, modern sanitation units, and pilgrim rest areas situated within 200 meters of all riverbanks and transit points.

medical.heading: 24/7 Medical Care & First-Aid Camps
medical.subheading: Primary Health Centers, ORS Hydration & 108 Ambulances
medical.description: Immediate access to medical assistance, heatstroke recovery units, and emergency helplines connected to district hospitals via dedicated green corridors.

heritage.heading: Historic Bridges & Spiritual Landmarks
heritage.subheading: Godavari Arch Bridge, Havelock Walkway & Kovvur Corridor
heritage.description: Cross the sacred Godavari River with monitored pedestrian pathways, heritage viewpoints, and seamless transit between Rajamahendravaram and Kovvur.
